objectives:
課程目標：
1. 寫作，閱讀，（再）改寫
2. 理論文章之簡短大要
3. 小說之閱讀詮釋
4. 廣告分析短文
content: "This course is designed to introduce and develop students’ skills in academic writing and evaluation, based on handwritten writing drafted in class. Students will write three essays; with one to two revisions for each draft. For each writing task we will read and watch relevant materials; we will start from the premise that good writing begins with analytical reading skills. Class meetings will consist of discussions of assigned readings, pre-writing and writing activities, group workshops, and paired peer evaluations of first and second drafts of each paper."
teaching_method:
講授
研討

個別指導
grading_policy:
課堂參與討論 (15%)
小組口頭報告 (15%)
精簡閱讀報告兩篇六稿 (20%)
閱讀分析一篇三稿 (20%)
廣告分析一篇三稿 (30%)
